trial_court: Sub Divisional Magistrate Shillai, District Sirmour (Cr. MMO No.1218 of 2023)
case_name: Kuldeep Kumar vs State Of H.P. And Others

parties.respondent_defendant: State of H.P. and others (wife, minor son's mother)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The applicant filed an application for issuing a search warrant to search the minor son and produce him before the court for handing over his custody to her. The respondent took the minor without returning him to the applicant, who is the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The remedy of the applicant was to approach the Court under the provision of Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956 to seek the custody of the minor.
legal_principles.held: The remedy of the applicant was to approach the Court under the provision of Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956 to seek the custody of the minor.

legal_principles.principle: The custody of a child by the father is not unlawful and does not constitute an offence.
legal_principles.held: The custody of a child by the father is not unlawful and does not constitute an offence.

legal_principles.principle: The custody of the minor aged less than 5 years has to remain ordinarily with the mother.
legal_principles.held: As per Section 6 of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, the custody of the minor aged less than 5 years has to remain ordinarily with the mother.

outcome.final_order: The final court order handed over the custody of the minor to the applicant.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing an order
